title: energy holdings buy ventura offshore form 1 billion group mulls us dual listing 2026 09 11
text:
Sept 11 (Reuters) - Cyprus-based oil and gas company Energy Holdings (ENH.OL)
, opens new tab
 has agreed to buy ​deepwater drilling contractor Ventura Offshore (VTURA.OL)
, opens new tab
 ‌to create a larger platform for cash generation, shareholder distribution and growth, the ​Oslo-listed companies said on Friday.
Under the ​agreement, Ventura shareholders would receive 605 ⁠million shares in Energy Holdings. ​That implies a pro forma equity ​value of about $1 billion for the combined company, based on Energy Holdings' last closing price ​and the maximum number of ​shares to be issued.
